utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you take a few flyers and help hand them out around the block?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can take a few flyers and hand them out around the block.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you bring the toolkit, the spare screws, and the repair log? If you have a flashlight too, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring the toolkit, spare screws, repair log, and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive—what do you need me to watch for?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo — maybe just keep an eye out for nails, screws, tape, and any spare tools folks bring by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep a lookout for nails, screws, tape, and any spare tools people drop off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting underway soon—what all still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We still need to sort the volunteer schedule, check what tools we have, and make sure the donation drop-off won’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help check the tools and keep the drop-off area organized if that’d be useful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Nell? Do you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: It’s going okay, I think — I’m still piecing together the latest updates. If you hear of any extra supplies or someone who can help, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check for extra supplies and ask around for help. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up, Gus — folks are bringing in all sorts of little fixes now. If you’ve got anything needing a tune-up, this seems like the day to do it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ve got a wobbly chair and a stubborn lamp I could bring by. I can also lend a few tools if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Gus — a wobbly chair and stubborn lamp are perfect repair-drive material. And lending tools is mighty neighborly; I’m sure somebody will need them!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’m telling everyone about the repair drive. If you want, I can help spread the word or point people to where they can sign up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Quinn — where should I send people to sign up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Send them to the sign-up sheet at the community center desk, or I can text you the link if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re actually available this Saturday? I don’t want to assume and end up short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m available this Saturday and can help out. Just tell me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s make a clear list of what needs fixing and who can help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the list and I’ll chip in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll put the list together and send it your way soon. We’ll make a solid plan and get folks helping where they can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading to the repair drive later, and I’ll make sure to mention the plan to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. Let me know the time and where to meet, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the time and meeting spot, then I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to check what folks still need, if I can remember where I put my list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort through it if you want. I’ve got a little time right now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a lifesaver, Uli. Let’s see if we can piece it together before I misplace the whole list again.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help keep everyone in the loop about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’ll pass along anything I hear while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — just send me any updates, and I’ll make sure the neighbors all hear about them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, the repair drive’s coming up soon—want me to put your name on the list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, put me down — I’ll probably be a little late, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll put you down. No worries about being late—just come by when you can and we’ll find you something useful to do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’d appreciate help sorting the tools and checking the list so I know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—I can help sort the tools and go over the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around the school schedule, and I’m happy to coordinate for the repair drive too. What do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — could you start with the school schedule first, then help coordinate the repair drive once that’s set?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll handle the school schedule first, then I’ll help coordinate the repair drive once that’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word and connect folks from both groups. What do you need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly hands on deck and a few volunteers with tools would help the most. I can keep repeating the plan to folks so we get both groups involved.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll round up volunteers and see who can bring tools, then I’ll pass your plan along to both groups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m just worried about who’s bringing what and whether we’ve got enough space to sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help sort that out — let’s make a quick list of who’s bringing what and I can bring a folding table or two for the setup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep track of the repair drive location and let you know the moment I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. Just let me know as soon as you confirm the location, and I’ll keep everything else lined up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m on it — I’ll confirm the repair drive location and tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get the parts list sorted yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I’m checking the details first so we don’t miss anything. I’ll confirm the parts list and let you know as soon as it’s sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Can you let me know once it’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any spare screwdrivers, tape, and a few flashlights? If you’re free, helping sort the donated supplies would be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll bring screwdrivers, tape, and a few flashlights, and I can help sort the donated supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah — it’s still going, I think. I’m a bit behind on the details too, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries — if you hear anything, just let me know. I’m trying to keep up with it too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right? I’m skeptical, but I want to make sure before I plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening — nothing’s been called off. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — I just wanted to confirm before I count on it. Let me know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m happy to check around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I knew I was forgetting something. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring a flashlight, a screwdriver, and any spare batteries you’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring a flashlight, a screwdriver, and any spare batteries I can find. I might need a quick reminder later, but I’ve got it!
